name: Intercontinental Presidente Cozumel Resort

address.street: Km 6.5 Carretera A Chankanaab Col. Zona Hotelera sur Col

insider_take: This beachfront paradise sits on Cozumel's pristine southwestern coast, where world-class diving meets laid-back Caribbean luxury.
whats_special: Located on the world's second-largest coral reef system, the hotel offers direct access to some of the planet's most spectacular diving sites. The property features Cozumel's only overwater spa treatment rooms and sits on a stretch of beach where sea turtles nest seasonally. The resort's position provides stunning sunset views over the Caribbean, while being just minutes from the vibrant downtown San Miguel.
pro_tip: Book diving excursions to Palancar Reef directly through the hotel's dive center - they offer exclusive early morning trips before the day boats arrive, giving you pristine visibility and virtually empty reefs.
dont_miss: The ancient Mayan ruins of San Gervasio, Cozumel's most important archaeological site dedicated to the goddess Ixchel. Take the hotel's complimentary shuttle to Chankanaab National Park for swimming with dolphins, or explore the island's only tequila distillery at Discover Mexico Park, just 10 minutes away.
pros: Prime beachfront location with direct access to beautiful coral reefs
World-class diving and snorkeling opportunities steps from the resort
Authentic Mexican hospitality with luxury amenities and services
Multiple dining venues featuring local and international cuisine
cons: Island location requires ferry or flight transfer from mainland
Hurricane season may affect travel plans during summer months
